pages.title: Dyson Sphere
pages.text: $(thing)Dyson Sphere$()$(br2)Close the swarm into a shell and capture a star's entire output.

$(thing)Insight$(): 120$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Dyson Swarm.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Higgs Field Capacitor.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A thin closed shell of radius r surrounds a star and absorbs all of its light. In equilibrium the shell radiates the star's whole luminosity from its outer surface only, as a black body at uniform temperature T. Write that luminosity as the radiated flux integrated over the shell in spherical coordinates.
